lines.1: Damn. The spot where Tetchan kicked me still hurt.
lines.2: That was far too much damage. I would not be satisfied until I got Otome back somehow.
lines.3: But I could not let myself get carried away either.
lines.4: Studying was a student's first duty, after all.
lines.6: And just when I was about to buckle down...
lines.7: 「Hey, Fukahire. Apparently Otome actually wants people to call her Tetchan.」
lines.8: 「Seriously?! So strong-willed women with a cute maidenly side really do exist!」
lines.9: 「I'll go call her that right now.」
lines.10: 「You're as stupid and entertaining as ever.」
lines.11: 「Did you just say something kind of awful?」
lines.12: 「No. I'm sure Otome would love hearing it from an accepting guy like you.」
lines.14: 「Roger! Maybe the real world isn't so bad after all!」
lines.16: 「And so he departed... May he at least rest in peace.」
lines.18: Footsteps thundered up to the second floor.
lines.19: That would be Otome, furious over what Fukahire told her.
lines.20: I immediately assumed a studious pose.
lines.21: 「Leo! You put some ridiculous idea in Samesuga's head, didn't you?!」
lines.22: 「Hmph... You're studying... Sorry to disturb you.」
lines.25: But I was not one to lower my guard here.
lines.33: They had sent in the next idiot assassin.
lines.34: 「Believe it or not, I'm as busy as a senior government official.」
lines.35: 「There are about ten new manga over there that I borrowed from Igaguri. Read those.」
lines.37: Whew. Now I could finally get some serious studying done.
